title: Baptism of Jesus Christ
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: How baptism is done differs among churches; only the place and the person who baptised Jesus are asked (FAITH).

skills.key_step: The child names the River Jordan and John the Baptist, and says John was humble (Matthew 3:13-15).

floor.question: What happened at Jesus' birth?
floor.answer: He was born in Bethlehem and laid in a manger

steps: Name the place and the person.

board.do: Draw a river with two people.
Wait for the child to say the Jordan.
Write: River Jordan, John the Baptist.

misconceptions.repair: Show a name card "John the Baptist" by a river picture.
Show a river picture. Read Matthew 3:13.

misconceptions.ask: What did John say when Jesus came?
